data.name: Asynchronauts
data.detailed_description:
An unexpected black hole anomaly has thrown your mission, and your timeline, totally off-course. Now, only you and your trusty AI companion remain.

It's up to you to solve the mystery of the Parallaxus System and discover the fate of the missing science colony-- at whatever pace you like.

The Parallaxus System hosted scientific research settlements, on the far edge of the galaxy.

Their research pointed towards finding new and bizarre physical materials with mindblowing unique properties-- all found across the five planets of this particular system.

Now, with the colony mysteriously vanished and their messages suddenly disrupted, it is up to you to explore the five main planets and their moons to learn what happened.

With a supermassive black hole suddenly appearing right at the edge of the system, time dilation has thrown a wrench into your mission plans. Just a few moments in Parallaxus means millions of years have passed in your home system...So it's fair to say, your long-extinct company isn't too worried about you coming back.

But look on the bright side! That means nobody to tell you what to do! Build a new, better multiplanetary society, in your own image! Populate it with robots! Change entire climates to your preference! Live in a cave, smacking rocks together and making grunting noises!

The five planets of Parallaxus each host one of the rare alien materials at the heart of the mystery, and each has wild alien landscapes and features. With all the time in the Universe to play around in your own stellar sandbox, you can explore and build settlements all across the main planets and several moons of the system. 

Unlock new materials and construction items by collecting data from old settlements and analyzing items and landmarks, and then build your dream home under the colorful rings of Prismata. Or maybe an armored bunker, so you can shelter in comfort from the diamond-rain of Lunessa.

Or, if you aren't content to settle down in your new home, learn the secrets that the vanished research colony did, and follow the trail they left behind to build the same devices. 

Leverage the far-out properties of the planets and moons of Parallaxus to create specialized factories, and optimize their output to help advance your research and investigation.

Unlock the secrets of the five exotic materials, and what physics-bending properties they hold, and combine them to make advanced technologies that lead you to the ultimate answer-- where is everybody?

  • A handcrafted single-player experience across a secret-packed star system

  • A narrating AI companion that keeps you company and keeps track of your progress and milestones-- construct them a new physical body to assist in your tasks!

  • Vibe your way across the planets with survival mechanics that are perk-focused and forgiving rather than punishing

  • A peaceful system in a violence-free utopian future: the only threats you'll face are the environmental hazards and your companion's razor wit

  • Exploit the unique properties of all five planets to increase your productivity and build more complex and demanding machines

  • Leverage the high-g and low-g environments of different planets to grow or shrink machines and xenos, or provide them with different qualities and output

  • Genetically engineer the primitive lifeforms of the system and cross-pollinate the planets

  • Craft, build, and automate your planetary factories. Find the perfect spot and build your dream base with hundreds of unlockable pieces and decor items

  • Gradually terraform the outer and inner planets into earthlike utopias to live on, or make them even more alien to increase their production output

  • Procedurally generated destinations-- the pull of the Supermassive Black Hole at the edge of the system pulls many rocky-bodied space objects through Parallaxus. Land on them as they pass through and collect rare and unique resources!

  • Creative mode to build the ultimate space-bases without resource requirements

data.short_description: A zany single-player, open-world survival-crafting adventure game, set in space across a colorful planetary system. Explore the system at your own pace, leverage the unique properties and lifeforms of the planets, build bases and factories, and reveal the mystery of a vanished science colony.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 - 64-bit
  • Processor: 4-core CPU
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Vulkan 1.2-capable, 4 GB VRAM
  • Storage: 6 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel HD Graphics 5000 or better
  • Storage: 6 GB available space
